newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican police arrest 15 after bombings.
newsitem.headline: Corsican police arrest 15 after bombings.

text.p: Police in Corsica detained 15 people, including seven women, on Monday in connection with a recent spate of bombings on the French Mediterranean island.
Two pistols, a revolver and a handgrenade were seized at the homes of three of those detained, as well as gas containers and detonators, police sources said.

Police, investigating a series of bombings blamed on separatist guerrillas since last November, said those being held were suspected of connections with the hardline Historic Wing of the Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC).
FLNC separatists have staged hundreds of bombings in a two-decade campaign for greater autonomy from mainland France for the resort island.
Recent targets have included tax and post offices, bank branches and offices of state-run companies France-Telecom and Air France.
